judged.play: 100T loses round 12 to make it 5-7, streamer watches replay with disappointment.
judged.line: No, no, no...
judged.reason: Disappointed reaction to a lost round replay with low energy compared to later hype moments.

judged.play: 100T wins a crucial eco round to close the gap to 6-7.
judged.line: Let's go! That's the energy!
judged.reason: Good energy for a key round win, but overshadowed by the intense endgame clutches in this stream.

judged.play: Crowd camera focuses on a female fan fixing her hair for the camera.
judged.line: She's like ah, gotta look pretty.
judged.reason: A lighthearted observational comment about a fan on camera, but too brief to be a main highlight.

judged.play: Standard round opening movements without any combat.
judged.reason: Routine gameplay setup with minimal reaction and no standout plays.

judged.play: Bang pulls off a clutch 1v2 on A site to tie the match 8-8.
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF HERE! Let's go!
judged.reason: Crucial 1v2 clutch by Bang to tie the game, accompanied by strong hype and funny commentary on silent opposing fans.

judged.play: Early round trades and mid control setup.
judged.line: Lovely baby.
judged.reason: Standard round gameplay with mild reaction compared to bigger round-winning moments.

judged.play: Streamer gives a motivational speech standing up before the round begins.
judged.line: It's time to rise, boys!
judged.reason: High energy motivational speech, but lacks a dramatic gameplay payoff within the clip.

judged.play: LOUD wins a round off a lucky shot to make it 9-9.
judged.line: Lucky shots bro, what the flip bro!
judged.reason: Brief reaction of dismay to an unlucky round loss.

judged.play: Streamer jokes with stream chat about LOUD fans during round buy phase.
judged.line: Psych, it's not all love man, get him out of here!
judged.reason: Funny banter with stream chat poking fun at opposing fans during round setup.

judged.play: 100T executes a flawless A site retake to reach 10-9.
judged.line: Oh my goodness! Let's freaking go baby!
judged.reason: Flawless site execute to retake the lead triggers an explosive, joyous reaction.

judged.play: Timeout screen shows VCT trophy, prompting streamer to flex and hype up his 100T jersey.
judged.line: I want to do some push-ups man, lift some weights!
judged.reason: Hilarious high-energy timeout moment where he gets so pumped by the trophy shot that he wants to do push-ups.

judged.play: 100T wins an A site defense round.
judged.line: Nice baby, nice!
judged.reason: Brief round-ending moment with standard hype.

judged.play: 100T secures round 20 to lead 11-9 while streamer mocks the quiet crowd.
judged.line: They are so quiet, it's insane!
judged.reason: Satisfying round win where he mocks the quiet crowd, but other clips have stronger play and reaction combos.

judged.play: 100T reaches match point at 12-9 off multi-kills.
judged.line: Oh my god, it's about to happen!
judged.reason: 100T securing match point prompts a wild reaction with the creator pulling his shirt over his head in disbelief.

judged.play: Tense match point round where 100T drops the spike in a 4v2.
judged.line: Check out this 4v2, ladies and gentlemen!
judged.reason: Tense match-point build-up, but the clip cuts before the final outcome.

judged.play: 100T calls timeout at 12-10 as LOUD mounts a comeback.
judged.line: You're not gonna see us do it!
judged.reason: High tension match-point commentary with his jersey draped over his head, though long and drawn out.

judged.play: LOUD completes comeback to force overtime at 12-12.
judged.line: What better way to take it all the way to the very end!
judged.reason: Coping with the heartbreak of LOUD forcing overtime with exaggerated optimism and replay analysis.

judged.play: 100T opens up site control in overtime round 25.
judged.line: Let's go!
judged.reason: Good OT round setup, but cuts off before the round fully resolves.

judged.play: LOUD wins a wild round to force another overtime tie.
judged.line: Oh my god! It's overtime in São Paulo!
judged.reason: Wild reaction to the match going to extended overtime, throwing a towel over his head in emotional overwhelm.

judged.play: 100T gets the spike down and wins an OT match point round.
judged.line: Let's go! We got spike on site!
judged.reason: Clutch overtime round win for match point, though other OT clips capture peak drama better.

judged.play: Replay shows sad LOUD fans in crowd; streamer jokes about a couple.
judged.line: She might break up with you! 'Why'd you bring me here?'
judged.reason: Hilarious commentary mocking a sad couple in the opposing Brazilian crowd during high-stakes overtime.
